invariants.name: every rendered series equals its payload
invariants.oracle: every chart's rendered series equals the payload it was fed - a chart is a claim about numbers, and a mark that does not match its datum is a lie no screenshot can catch

invariants.name: a closed period's snapshot never changes
invariants.oracle: a closed period's analytics_snapshots row never changes; re-running produces the same row

invariants.name: snapshot and live agree or the surface says which it shows
invariants.oracle: a snapshot and the live truth views agree for the same period, or the surface states which of the two it is showing

invariants.name: insufficient data never renders as zero
invariants.oracle: insufficient data renders as insufficient, never as zero - a zero OEE and an unknown OEE are opposite things to a plant manager

invariants.name: batch-risk-scoring is idempotent
invariants.oracle: batch-risk-scoring is idempotent per hive + period

invariants.name: no chart aggregates a foreign hive
invariants.oracle: no chart aggregates another hive's rows - tenant isolation through the aggregate path, where it is easiest to lose

domain_truths.name: OEE = A x P x Q and names the drag
domain_truths.oracle: OEE = availability x performance x quality per ISO 22400, and the surface says which of the three is dragging it down
